outcome: Levels of various cytokines (IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, Eotaxin, MIB-1beta, VEGF, IL-15, IL-2, IL-5, IL-9, IL-10, IL-1ra, IL-7, IL-12)
cohort: 25 pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection and 16 of their newborns
finding: Vaccinated pregnant women and their newborns had higher levels of cytokines, IgG antibodies, and memory T cells compared to non-vaccinated mothers and their newborns.
